name: V3-Z2-PC

purpose.what_this_is: An INSTRUMENT CHECK on the V3-Z1 inference pipeline. It asks whether that pipeline can detect a known-true effect (volatility persistence) and whether it rejects at its nominal rate when no effect exists. It is NOT an edge hunt.
purpose.why_it_is_needed: 24 predeclared primary hypotheses across V2_PROXY and V3-Z1 have returned zero promotions. A pipeline that always returns null is, on that evidence alone, indistinguishable from a broken one. This resolves that ambiguity.
purpose.what_a_pass_means: the instrument has demonstrated sensitivity and correct size. The prior nulls become credible evidence about the market rather than about the code. It does NOT promote any trading signal, does NOT imply a directional edge, and does NOT authorize strategy work.
purpose.what_a_fail_means: a defect exists in the shared machinery. V1, V2_PROXY and V3-Z1 conclusions must be re-read before any of them is relied on. The response is a defect hunt, NOT a new model class.

design_principle: identical data, identical code path, identical inference - only the QUESTION changes. A control that runs through different machinery calibrates nothing, so every shared component is imported from z1_panel / z1_design / v2_inference rather than reimplemented.
shared_with_z1_unchanged: log_returns and the 2h maximum gap rule
session_bucket coding and the asia reference
what_changes: the OUTCOME is future realized variance, not direction
the PREDICTORS are lagged realized variance at three scales (HAR)
there is no promotion, no replication stage and no strategy path

outcome.why_this_horizon: EXACTLY the horizon V3-Z1 used, so the control runs on essentially the same rows with the same censoring pattern. Comparability with the experiment being calibrated matters more than a smoother outcome.
outcome.drafted_then_rejected: a 6-hour forward window was drafted first. It censored hso 17-22 entirely - the window cannot cross the 17:00 ET maintenance break - which emptied the us_midday and us_close buckets and produced a RANK-DEFICIENT design. The frozen absent-category rule caught it before any outcome existed.
outcome.known_cost: log(r^2) over a single bar is a NOISY proxy for log variance (log chi-square, 1 df, variance pi^2/2 ~ 4.93). This ATTENUATES the standardized coefficient; it does not bias the sign or invalidate the test. The thresholds below are set against the ATTENUATED expectation, not against unattenuated literature values.
outcome.censoring: CENSORED, never bridged, wherever t+1 is not the genuine next hour

predictors.form: hourly HAR, all in logs of per-bar mean variance
predictors.rule: each uses only bars CLOSED AT OR BEFORE t; gap returns are omitted from the window, never fabricated; a partial window yields MISSING rather than a downward-biased estimate
predictors.standardization: all three standardized with FROZEN development constants, fitted on predictor values only, reading no outcome

model.equation: Y_vol(t) = alpha + b_s*rv_short(t) + b_d*rv_day(t) + b_w*rv_week(t) + SUM_b delta_b*session_b(t) + eps(t)
model.inference: CR1 clustered by CME trade date, Student-t(G-1)
model.session_fixed_effects: INCLUDED deliberately. NQ intraday volatility seasonality is large; without these the test would partly 'detect' time-of-day rather than persistence, which would make passing trivial and the control meaningless.

sample.counts_are: ELIGIBILITY ONLY - computed from a PRESENCE predicate, no outcome value

power_check.rule_introduced_here: no pass threshold may be declared BELOW the design's MDE at 80% power, computed before outcomes. V3-Z1 violated this: it declared a 0.03 economic floor while its MDE was 0.071, so it could not certify the effect it said it cared about.
power_check.verdict: SATISFIED - the expected effect is 1.9x to 3.5x the MDE
power_check.honest_correction: an earlier informal estimate quoted |t| ~ 12-24 for this control. That assumed an UNATTENUATED effect. With the single-bar log(r^2) proxy the realistic range is |t| ~ 5-10. The control remains decisive but is less overwhelming than first stated.

stage_A1_sensitivity.question: can the pipeline detect a known-true effect?
pass_requires_all: joint Wald test of {b_s, b_d, b_w} has p < 1e-4
|standardized b_s| >= 0.0698 (the design's own MDE, per the rule above)
stage_A1_sensitivity.threshold_rationale: 4.0 sits BELOW the conservative expected |t| of ~5 so a genuine effect passes comfortably, yet far above noise (p ~ 6e-5 at df=367). Set before outcomes and never tuned.

stage_A2_specificity.question: does the pipeline reject at its nominal rate when NO effect exists?
stage_A2_specificity.procedure: block-permute the three HAR predictors ACROSS trade dates - whole-date blocks, so within-date dependence and the predictors' mutual correlation are preserved while the link to the outcome is destroyed. Refit the identical frozen model. 1,000 permutations, seed 20260914.
stage_A2_specificity.recorded: empirical rejection rate for b_s at alpha = 0.05 two-sided
stage_A2_specificity.band_rationale: Monte-Carlo SE at p=0.05 with 1,000 reps is 0.0069, so +/-3 SE is about [0.029, 0.071]. The band is slightly wider to avoid a false alarm from MC noise, yet far tighter than the 0.20-0.40 rejection rate a naive iid test would show against this much within-day dependence.
stage_A2_specificity.why_this_matters_most: this directly tests the SIZE of the CR1 p-values used throughout V2_PROXY and V3-Z1. Over-rejection would mean those nulls survived an anti-conservative test and are even more convincing. Under-rejection would mean the tests were too conservative and could have masked real effects. Both readings matter and the two-sided band catches both.

stage_B_deliberately_absent.decision: NO research hypothesis is preregistered in this document.
stage_B_deliberately_absent.why: calibrate the instrument, THEN design the experiment. Preregistering a research hypothesis now would mean committing to it before knowing whether the instrument works, which is backwards. If A1 and A2 pass, a separate preregistration may follow.
stage_B_deliberately_absent.warning_for_any_future_stage_B: any added feature must NOT be a linear combination of the HAR components already in the model. A short-versus-long log variance ratio, for example, is exactly the algebraic redundancy that Amendment 01 removed from Z1 - conditional on rv_short and rv_week it spans nothing new.
